About this item

  • Purpose-made for the recovery of oil and antifreeze, the pan helps to keep the workshop floor free from oily residue and aid return of oil to recycling containers with minimum risk of spills or splashes.
  • Made from high-density Polyethylene with UV stabiliser. Heavy wall construction stays rigid, even with hot oil.
  • Excess capacity helps prevent overflow or spillage. Large handles positioned to aid carrying and pouring.
  • Resistant to most chemicals and solvents.
  • Will not dent or rust and are easy-to-clean. Includes drain vent to aid smooth flow of oil.
  • ONE YEAR GUARANTEE FROM A REPUTABLE UK COMPANY – Founded in 1978, Sealey is a large family run business with a vast product range. Trusted by professionals, all Sealey products are thoroughly tested and backed by unrivalled aftersales service.

From the manufacturer

Sealey DRP07 10ltr Oil/Fluid Drain & Recycle Container

  • Suitable for both the DIY user and professional mechanic.
  • Purpose-made for the recovery of oil and antifreeze, the pan helps to keep the workshop floor free from oily residue and aid return of oil to recycling containers with minimum risk of spills or splashes.
  • Made from high density Polyethylene with UV stabiliser.
  • Heavy wall construction stays rigid, even with hot oil.
  • Excess capacity helps prevent overflow or spillage.
  • Large handles positioned to aid carrying and pouring.
  • Resistant to most chemicals and solvents.
  • Will not dent or rust and are easy to clean.
  • Includes drain vent to aid smooth flow of oil.

About us

Founded in 1978, Sealey is now known nationally and internationally as a professional tools and workshop equipment. Committed to selling through a network of local, independent dealers, we have a reputation for providing the best products, best value and a service that is second to none.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      I will start this review by saying that I have only used this product once.

      The use of the drain pan is very self explanatory but comes with instructions regardless explaining the different plugs and applications for them. Previous reviews say that the oil splashes out of the pan or doesn’t drain quick enough but in my experience, none of these have been the case. Oil drained nicely and clean. Upon refitting all of the plugs, a quick wipe with a paper towel allows a clean transport of the oil. Good value for money especially with the hassle it saves of having to drain into a pan and then relocated into a sealed container.

    Product Description
    Suitable for both the DIY user and professional mechanic.
